cases.question: What are the three stages of a classic RAG pipeline?
cases.purpose: Relevant document path; retrieve real RAG evidence, keep relevant chunks, generate and run original LLM grounding grader.

cases.question: What does the faithfulness metric in RAGAS measure?
cases.purpose: Evaluation-knowledge retrieval and relevance filtering among real mixed-topic chunks.
cases.answer_evidence: data/documents/evaluation_ragas.md:11-14; support of generated claims by retrieved context

cases.question: According to my documents, why does RAG use an embedding model to retrieve relevant text chunks?
cases.purpose: Controlled no-relevant-evidence fixture; real graders should reject actual store-review chunks, execute bounded rewriting, then original web fallback.
cases.answer_evidence: No RAG/embedding explanation exists in this copied product-review corpus. Recovery must not fabricate document provenance.

conditions.device: actual MPS for Laya; configured SentenceTransformer defaults; Ollama Metal

protocol.index: Use native ingestion at chunk size 800/overlap 120 on isolated copies only; close preparation process, freeze logical index contents, clone each snapshot for each run.
protocol.observability: LangChain callbacks, LangGraph update/value streams and read-only model hooks outside original nodes; no monkeypatching model decisions, sources or graph nodes.
protocol.timing: Measure native graph.stream entry to completion, including all nodes/conditional branches, retrieval and network fallback. Report preparation/model loading separately; do not equate with C1 grader-only latencies.
protocol.counts: Count actual LLM calls by role and Laya SDK/forward calls; separately count retrieval embedding forwards, source-tool activity and preparation.
protocol.live_web: Use original real DDGS search on recovery. Web results can change between sequential runs and are logged; this is an integration validation, not a controlled answer-quality benchmark.
protocol.pass_criteria: Native execution completes without integration error; LLM Router route remains observed, document outputs match actual per-document grader decisions, original transitions/retry limits and recovery hold, generation/grounding stay LLM, nonempty final response. Report answer/provenance problems separately; do not tune or fix.
